D.t: Maggie Goodlander leads by 20.6 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 70,783 votes; a one point swing is about 1,721 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +12.7 and D +28.2. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$2.4M cash against $663K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.

R.t: Lily Tang Williams trails by 20.6 and wins 0% of simulations. Closing it takes about 35,391 voters switching sides, or 70,783 more net votes from new turnout.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +28.2 and D +12.7. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$663K cash against $2.4M. Outspent: lean on earned media, digital, field and the outside groups, and pick the two or three media markets that decide it.
